questions.text: If n has  3, then the statement a[++n]=n++;
questions.solution:
n is modified twice (++n and n++) in one statement without a sequence point. This is undefined behaviour in C, so the result depends on the compiler.

Answer: what is assigned is compiler dependent

y is increased before it is used (pre-increment ++y). x is used first and increased after (post-increment x++).

Answer: z = (x++) + (++y);
